candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark is primary acinic cell carcinoma of the breast, a rare salivary gland-type tumor supported by acinar differentiation and S100/SOX10/GCDFP-15/PASD positivity. Invasive ductal carcinoma of no special type does not preserve the required acinic cell subtype.
